assessments.name: Creative & Reflective Portfolio
assessments.description: A curated submission including a written reflection, a creative prompt/design for group improvisation, and peer feedback summary. Optional short audio/video solo example to support written reflection.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 16 Nov 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Engagement & Contribution
assessments.description: Assessed based on in-class participation, listening, preparedness, punctuality, risk-taking, and verbal contributions over the semester.

assessments.name: Early Learning Task – Improvisation Participation & Reflection
assessments.description: Short ensemble improvisation task during class
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Final Ensemble Performance
assessments.description: Final group and/or small ensemble improvisation presented in a live setting. Assessed on listening, collaboration, creativity, and professionalism.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Weekly Reflections on Discussion Board
assessments.description: Weekly written reflections must be posted to the discussion board by 11:59pm the evening before class. Reflections should address the student's own creative development and the content covered in class, and must be posted even in weeks a class is missed.
